speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcript: This is AgriPaul's drive time brought to you by Curious Plot, a full-service marketing communications and consulting agency driven to find what's next for food and agriculture clients. Learn more online at curiousplot.agency. Good Tuesday afternoon, I'm Hannah Paggle. A Missouri lawmaker is looking to educate consumers on plant-based meat alternatives with a new labeling bill. Republican Congressman Mark Alford is leading the Fair and Accurate Ingredient Representation of Labels Act of 2024. The legislation would require the use of imitation or similar terminology on labels of plant-based meat alternatives. It would also require cell-cultured or lab grown to be prominently displayed on the packaging of products that are produced from a tissue sample and grown through the culturing process in a lab. Allford says the legislation will help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.
